testimony.subject: Fee patent receipt, disposition of allotted land
testimony.key_claims: John Mullen, age 35, is a Rosebud Sioux allottee who received a fee patent he did not apply for. It was delivered by the Burke Postmaster at Lucas without him signing a receipt. He accepted it without protest. He no longer owns the land, having traded it for other land. He is in good health and supports a wife, 3 children, and his father by his own work.
